scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @wahala/shared && concurrently --kill-others --names server,client "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace @wahala/shared && npm run dev --workspace server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build --workspace @wahala/shared && npm run dev --workspace client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @wahala/shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names server,client "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client"
scripts.lint: eslint server/src server/test packages/shared/src e2e playwright.config.ts && npm run lint --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @wahala/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @wahala/shared && npm run test --workspace server
